name: What are common signs that my deck needs maintenance or repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my deck needs maintenance or repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your deck needs maintenance include warped, cracked, or rotting boards, loose railings, unstable posts, visible mold or mildew growth, and faded or peeling stain/sealant. Puddling water or structural movement when walking on the deck are also critical indicators. Addressing these issues promptly can prevent further damage and costly repairs, especially with the varied weather conditions in the East Bay area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for warped boards, loose railings, mold, or faded sealant. Puddling water or structural movement also signal a need for maintenance.
